description: Unit test code for trailer parsing functions, including tests for trailer iterator behavior with various input formats and edge cases.

methods.name: t_trailer_iterator
methods.description: Helper function to iterate over trailer lines in a message and compare with expected contents.

methods.name: test_trailer__empty_input
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with empty input.

methods.name: test_trailer__no_newline_start
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with input starting without a newline.

methods.name: test_trailer__newline_start
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with input starting with a newline.

methods.name: test_trailer__no_body_text
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with input containing headers and trailers but no body text.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_text_no_divider
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with body text and multiple trailers without a divider.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_no_divider_2nd_block
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with multiple trailer blocks, last one taking precedence.

methods.name: test_trailer__body_and_divider
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with a divider line present.

methods.name: test_trailer__non_trailer_in_block
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with non-trailer lines within a trailer block.

methods.name: test_trailer__too_many_non_trailers
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with a block below the trailer percentage threshold.

methods.name: test_trailer__one_non_trailer_no_git_trailers
methods.description: Test trailer iterator with mostly non-trailer lines, not considered a trailer block.
